usedFor: Unbounce captures landing page leads, and Sangam CRM receives them when “New Lead Arrives” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Arrives” in Unbounce, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each landing page lead reaches your CRM, matched by email or phone against existing leads.

watchOut: “New Lead Arrives” in Unbounce is polling, so “Create or Update Lead” runs after a scheduled check.
